formal_statement: ∀ (n s : ℕ) (T : List (Option Bool)), T.length = 2 ^ n → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide (T.getD (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.tableIndex x) none = some true)) s → (List.replicate s true ++ false :: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.encodePartial T) ∈ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.PartialMCSP
plain_statement: If the total function that is 1 exactly where the partial table T is defined as 1 has a circuit with s gates, then T with bound s is in partial MCSP. The one new step in carrying the Murray and Williams argument over to partial tables: large bounds are yes-instances.
title: Zero completion: a small circuit for the 1-entries makes a partial MCSP instance a member
